title: CLR/31/2015 of Bhomesh Sharma Vs Shashikant AND OTHERS

paras.text:
CLR No. 31 of 2012
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. B.D. Pandey, Advocate for the
revisionist.
None for the respondents.
Mr. Pandey, Advocate for the
revisionist seeks some time to take
appropriate steps for substitution of
legal heirs of respondent no.1 after her
death.
Such steps be taken within two
weeks after expiry of winter vacation.
List after substitution application
is moved by the revisionist.
Urgency application (IA No.80 of
2016) stands disposed of.
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.)
 07.01.2016
NISHANT
